title: Edwards iXH/iXM Dry Pump Chemical Powder Fouling (NH4Cl / SiF4) Recovery
content: When high-frequency rotor vibration (5-11 kHz band) exceeds 3-sigma reconstruction error on CVD or Etch dry pumps using SiH4, NH3, or WF6 gases, chemical byproduct solidification ('chemical snow') is occurring on exhaust stages. MANDATORY ACTION: Immediately abort Eco/Idle turndown, lock VFD at 100% nominal RPM, increase N2 ballast purge to 40 slm, keep pump body temperature above 105 C, and schedule hot-nitrogen purge flush SOP-PM-04 during next PM window. NEVER execute emergency pump shutdown during active wafer processing.

title: Byproduct Condensation Guardbands for LPCVD/PECVD Forelines
content: Ammonium chloride (NH4Cl) and silicon-fluoride byproducts sublimate and deposit as solid powder below 90 C in dry pump exhaust manifolds. Control Barrier Function (CBF) and Safety PLC hard clamps MUST enforce T_exhaust >= T_condensation + 5 C (minimum 95 C for standard nitride/oxide recipes, 110 C for harsh tungsten WF6 recipes). Standard Viton/Si MKS 925 gauges are restricted to clean or N2-diluted forelines; harsh HF/Cl2/WF6 lines require heated Inconel Baratron capacitance manometers.

title: Non-Invasive Flow Verification (Keyence FD-Q20C) & 3-Way Rinse Diversion
content: Clamp-on ultrasonic flow sensors (Keyence FD-Q20C, IP67, 1/2 to 3/4 inch pipes) verify wet-bench UPW rinse flow without cutting fluoropolymer pipes or introducing particle contamination. During a 60-second wafer rinse cycle, initial 10 seconds carry acid/slurry carryover and must route to Industrial Wastewater Treatment (IWT). During final 50 seconds, once existing inline resistivity exceeds 15-18.18 MOhm-cm and TOC < 1 ppb (ASTM D5127), toggle 3-way reclaim valve to Direct UPW Polishing Loop (~75% recovery). During idle standby, execute intermittent pulse flushing to prevent biofilm growth.

title: SEMI E187 Air-Gapped OT AI & SEMI S2 PLC Safety Interlock Mandate
content: All AI optimization agents must execute strictly on-premise inside the air-gapped OT server room (SEMI E187 compliant) with zero cloud internet dependency. Direct actuator control from software AI servers is prohibited: AI agents may only transmit bounded setpoint requests over OPC-UA/Modbus TCP to existing SEMI S2 certified Safety PLCs. If SECS/GEM reports PROCESS_ACTIVE=HIGH, or server watchdog heartbeat drops >1.0 second, or ADWIN drift detector flags Out-of-Distribution (OOD) shift >3 sigma, the PLC immediately defaults all pumps and UPW valves to 100% Fail-Rich nominal baseline.

title: Coupled Sub-Fab Heat Rejection Feed-Forward to Central Chiller Plant
content: When Sub-Fab Vacuum Agent forecasts bay-wide pump idle turndown via MES/AMHS schedule 15 minutes ahead, it broadcasts expected heat-rejection reduction (kW_th) to the Chiller/HVAC Agent. Central chillers proactively adjust compressor staging and cooling tower fan speed within strict chilled water supply bounds [7.0 C, 7.5 C], preventing reactive over-cooling lag and cutting additional Scope 2 electricity and cooling-tower evaporation water.
